description: Synthetic/de-identified approved OASIS and Plan of Care evidence for Abdul's clinician RAG assistant prototype.

evidence.text: Approved OASIS field: primary diagnosis is congestive heart failure with hypertension listed as a comorbidity.
Approved review note: patient was discharged after a recent hospitalization for shortness of breath and fluid overload.
Approved OASIS mobility field: patient requires a walker and one-person assistance for safe transfers and ambulation.
Approved safety assessment: patient is at high fall risk due to impaired balance, recent weakness, and cluttered bedroom pathway.
Approved Plan of Care snippet: medication reconciliation is required because the patient reports confusion about morning and evening doses.
Approved Plan of Care intervention: provide fall-prevention education, review walker use, monitor cardiopulmonary symptoms, and reinforce medication schedule.
Approved draft goal: patient will verbalize fall-prevention steps and demonstrate safe walker positioning during the care episode.
Unapproved raw OCR text mentions insulin sliding scale but this was not validated by a clinician.
Approved OASIS field: primary diagnosis is chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
